name: Liberation Day Tariff Shock — April 2025
description: Trump announces sweeping reciprocal tariffs on April 2, erasing $6T from markets in two days. S&P drops 12.4%. On April 9 a 90-day pause triggers a 9.5% single-day rebound — largest since 2008. Two weeks of pre-shock calm, the crash, and the whipsaw recovery.
